faqs.a: A make-ready is work to prepare a rental property for its next tenant. Depending on the property, that can include cleaning, touch-ups, debris removal and exterior work. The scope is discussed for each project.

faqs.q: How much does a make-ready cost?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on the property's size and condition, the requested work, location and timing. Tell us about the project and request a custom quote.

faqs.q: How soon can the work be done?
faqs.a: Tell us your desired completion date when you contact us. We respond within 24 hours; the work schedule depends on the scope and availability.

faqs.q: Can property managers send a checklist or request work on multiple units?
faqs.a: Yes. Share your checklist, the number of units, locations and requested dates so we can discuss the project and availability.
We consider projects in Austin, Hutto, Taylor, Round Rock, Pflugerville, Manor, Jarrell and other nearby communities, generally within about 50 miles of Austin. Contact us to confirm your location.
